status: Offline sleep/wake ownership trace and screen-admission correction validated. Physical suspend/resume and idle-drain qualification remain untested.
address_convention: Ghidra virtual addresses in explicitly selected ARM64 v8A ELF programs; imported kernel external symbols are references, not local implementations.

inventory.scope: ELF module symbol tables in the listed containers were scanned for PM references. Counts include duplicate files across containers; they do not report loaded modules or complete behavioral analysis of every driver.

kernel_configuration.meaning: Userspace SystemSuspend owns the wakeup_count/state protocol; absence of kernel autosleep is not evidence of a defect.
kernel_configuration.preservation: Keep the retained DTB, module load/dependency metadata, matching GKI interface and vendor-hook/CFI compatibility. No module or PM configuration is changed in this work.

core.device_tree: mediatek,mtk-lpm at /mtk-lpm; pinned stock DTB contains suspend-method=enable and common-sodi=1.
core.disable_gate: Missing or non-enable suspend-method leaves the native disable bit set; the module registers and holds lpm_lock. This is a configuration safeguard, not a wake lock to suppress.
core.selection: pm_suspend_default_s2idle selects the s2idle path; otherwise native registers its system suspend/resume syscore operations.
core.callbacks: lpm_suspend_registry 0x1028a0 installs model callback pointers under the module spinlock. System enter 0x10277c honors the disable bit and invokes the model; resume 0x102820 invokes its paired callback.
core.s2idle: 0x103048 wraps the original cpuidle entry with model/notifier callbacks before and after idle. Preserve the native per-CPU/context-tracking lifecycle.
core.sync: Early PM callback 0x103430 queues filesystem sync and sets sys_sync_ongoing. Worker 0x1029a0 syncs and clears the flag under its lock. Late PM callback 0x103514 waits in 10 ms intervals and can return a stop/bad notifier result if sync remains pending.

platform.dependency_order: Stock vendor_dlkm modules.load: mtk-lpm line 193, debug-common line 194, platform line 195, SoC debug line 196; platform declares dependencies on core and debug-common.
platform.system_resume: 0x1007f8 calls lpm_do_mcusys_prepare_on, then the optional resume observer.
platform.s2idle: 0x10088c tracks CPUs entering idle and prepares only when all online CPUs have entered. 0x10097c restores on the corresponding all-CPU condition and clears each CPU bit.
platform.hotplug_pair: PM callback 0x100aa0 disables CPU hotplug on event 3 and reenables on event 4. Keep the prepare/post pairing.
platform.wake_irqs: Initialization registers the mediatek,sleep interrupt as wake-capable and communicates its IRQ through the retained SMC interface; PBUS IRQs have their own wake configuration.

userspace_suspend.power_manager: PowerManagerService.updateSuspendBlockerLocked acquires required blockers before HAL transition, defers noninteractive until displays are ready, releases obsolete blockers, then enables autosuspend when allowed.
userspace_suspend.standard_hal: Retained setMode 0x10cf70 routes INTERACTIVE through capability 0xd4. False invokes eligible scenario cleanup; true invokes restore. The capability gate must not be assumed enabled from API success alone.
userspace_suspend.native_cleanup: libpowerhal perfUserScnDisableAll 0x152f80 skips screen-off states 1 and 3, disables eligible active scenarios and clears selected dead-process scenarios. perfUserScnRestoreAll 0x1531e0 sets its interactive flag; it does not eagerly restore all old handles.
userspace_suspend.system_suspend: SystemSuspend checks live client tokens and its suspend counter, writes the observed wakeup_count back and writes mem to power/state while holding the suspend mutex. Framework restart reenables autosuspend and releases zygote_kwl. Preserve these ownership and race-prevention rules.

honor_power_service.event_thread: UeventInit 0x10bb00 starts a detached event worker. UeventEvent 0x10b920 polls netlink when callbacks exist; without listeners it sleeps. These worker paths do not acquire a suspend blocker.
honor_power_service.cleanup: Power destructor 0x108350 destroys shared storage, death recipient and callback map. Do not treat this charging/event service as the Android autosuspend controller.

userspace_suspend.uniperf_admission: UniPerfServer::DoNotificationEvent 0x115130 handles event 20226 with one integer by updating its independent screen-admission field. This path is separate from standard Power HAL scenario cleanup.

charging_safety.owner: Retained stock smart_charge_mtk and honor_charger_manager_mtk modules.
charging_safety.micro_short: Stock category-1 event 8 enables delayed collection; event 9 disables/deletes it. Create 0x1025c4 acquires the safety wake source, delete 0x1026dc relaxes it. At CONFIG_HZ=250 the 7500-jiffy delay is 30 seconds, not a guaranteed collection duration.
charging_safety.charge_control: Plugin/plugout handlers 0x125c6c/0x125d78 pair wake-source acquire/release. Full-charge unlock in routine 0x12639c has charger-type, status, capacity, support and watchdog-success gates.
charging_safety.init_scope: Stock charger load_system_cfg writes pm_async=0; other stock boot/charger triggers set pm_freeze_timeout=2000. These are conditional init actions, not proof of current runtime values.
charging_safety.decision: Keep stock charging and battery-safety wake locks. No blanket wake-lock blocking, charging change or forced suspend is introduced.

lineage_correction.before: Missing audio/camera services returned before registering screen events. Audio or Battery Saver query failures could release frequency votes without forwarding the observed sleep/wake state.
lineage_correction.after: Register screen events whenever the power source is present. Read interactive state independently. Missing/failing workload inputs force frequency release while the observed interactive state still reaches UniPerf.
lineage_correction.unknown_screen: An unavailable screen query releases this service frequency votes without inventing an interactive/noninteractive notification.
lineage_correction.ownership: Only this service client-1 CPU/GPU limits are released; thermal client 2 and native safety wake sources are retained.

validation.red_test: The host service harness fails against the previous service with an empty screen-state history when audio is absent.
validation.host_limits: The service test compiles the actual service and policy/controller with explicit Android/backend fakes. It checks lifecycle logic, not Android Binder delivery or physical sleep.

hardware_followup: Incoming call, alarm, Bluetooth and fingerprint wake
